avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may reduce cyclobenzaprine levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal products

avoid_supplements.name: Valerian Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression may cause excessive sedation and impaired cognition
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid combination; if used, monitor closely for somnolence and dizziness

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; use alternative muscle relaxation therapies

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase cyclobenzaprine concentrations
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased adverse effects; dose adjustment may be needed

caution_supplements.name: Passionflower
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; counsel on avoiding activities requiring alertness

caution_supplements.name: 5-HTP
caution_supplements.mechanism: Theoretical serotonergic interaction; additive sedation risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive drowsiness; separate dosing if possible

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases cyclobenzaprine bioavailability and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate grapefruit products from diet during cyclobenzaprine therapy

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase cyclobenzaprine absorption and peak concentrations
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; maintain routine for stable levels

caution_foods.name: Alcohol-Containing Foods (Kombucha, Certain Sauces)
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and increased sedation risk
caution_foods.action: Minimize consumption; counsel patient on alcohol avoidance during therapy

monitoring_notes: Monitor for excessive CNS depression, dry mouth, and dizziness, particularly when cyclobenzaprine is combined with alcohol or other CNS depressants. Educate patients to avoid driving and hazardous activities until individual tolerance is established.
